## Requirements (contract)

1. Reviewed pilot evidence pack + ledger over the official city usage page,
   the council memo/amendment, procurement/policy material, and scoped UVED
   legal material — with capture availability and signature/digest uncertainty
   recorded.
2. Correct the seeded flagship interpretation **additively**: separate
   metro/city/owned/private/access scopes; label the derived approximate 190;
   never rewrite history.
3. Retention/sharing/renewal answers with exact exceptions and authority
   status; rights/review gaps stay explicit.

### Out of scope (must NOT do)

- No source rights flip, no live fetch, no human labels or fabricated review,
  no publication, no main integration, no destructive claim edits.
- Consume the P32.12 connector and P32.17 dossier machinery; do not fork them.

## Design notes

- `ops/src/ops/dossier_packet.py` — builds `sig.dossier-packet/1` by replaying
  `dossier_documents` over the three committed OKC fixtures verbatim (the
  connector's own emit, including `present_but_empty` signature field-states),
  plus authored records for the P06.1 journalism pack and the committed
  shadow-document transcription fixtures (statute/ops-manual/procurement).
  Emits the dossier, portfolio, print HTML, `EVIDENCE_PACK.md`, and
  `LIVE_RETURN_PASS.json` (`sig.dossier-live-return-pass/1`, D-P32.18-1).
- `ops/src/ops/seed_correction.py` — `sig.seed-correction-packet/1`: the five
  pre-P32.3 legacy records as verbatim targets (resolved by `content_digest`),
  corrected replacements carrying `count_scope`/`count_scope_detail` +
  `evidence_origin=seed_fixture`, `revises_claim` + `correction_reason`, and
  `derived_labels[]` for the ~190 roll-up (`derive_approximate_sum` — L4 label,
  never a claim). `apply_packet(dsn, dry_run=)` closes each target's belief
  window with the one permitted §16.6 UPDATE and inserts replacements through
  `PgClaimSink` in ONE transaction (sink binds the same conn; chunk transaction
  nests as a savepoint — crash-safe); dry-run reports only; re-apply is
  `already_applied` +0; a post-P32.3 spine reports `no_target`.
- Shared `exports.research_dossier` fixes (consumed, not forked):
  `_scope_labels` accepts the emitted qualifier shape; q12 stops counting
  itself as an unknown; derived answers no longer double-log ledger rows;
  a derived question renders its non-input claims as labelled `context` so a
  derived ~190 cannot hide the 299-metro count.
- CLI: additive `sig-ops dossier-packet --out <dir>` and
  `sig-ops seed-correct [--dsn] [--packet] [--dry-run]`.
